reasons: Cited § 8.2 matches the preferred position: successive twelve-month (not multi-year) automatic renewals, Customer opt-out on 30 days' notice (≤30), and a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, with a customer-favourable extension if the reminder is missed.
§ 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%, exactly the preferred cap, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.
Rationale correctly reasons that § 8.1's three-year initial term is a negotiated initial commitment, not an automatic multi-year renewal, so the walk-away trigger is not engaged.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment is proposed and the rendered text is unchanged; the deterministic notice-window check confirms 30 days.
